prerequisites: Students are expected to have prior knowledge of electrical networks, information transfer and processing, general physics including mechanics, electricity and magnetism.

learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to analyze networks with resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, transistors and op-amps in DC, in the frequency domain and in the time domain
The student is able to create small-signal equivalent models for transistors and diodes
The student is able to analyze networks with resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, transistors and op-amps for small signals
The student understands the difference between a DC, AC and TRAN network analysis in a simulator and can apply this to an example

syllabus_topics: Electrical components and DC network analysis
Network analysis in the time domain, in the frequency domain and the Bode plot
The diode: circuits with diodes and small-signal model
assessment_rules: 100% of the score is based on the oral exam during the exam series. The exam is closed book without a formula sheet. If the evaluation shows that the student has insufficiently achieved one or more objectives of the course, the overall result may deviate from the weighted average of the components.
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
